Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, to be performed on an 
 (1/4) 
 annually bases as indicated by M3 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Issy tested by eng. Mohamed Hussein Sherif accepted by general director 
 eng. Mohamed Kamel Afify and 
 approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour Power Station 
 and MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Stop the unit
Isolate the air fan mechanical & 
 electrical
To lose the pressure
Tools 
and Equipment
Workshop kit (spanners & wrenches)
Screw drivers & gear pullers ... 
 etc
General purpose grease
Power supply panel
Hoisting
Scaffolding & Hoisting
Amyant
Welding equipment
Work to be 
carried out
Operate to check the performance
Define the troubles
Dissassemble the defective units
Remove the insulation
Check external body and joints
Check the gates (inner quill) for 
 the gases
Check the flanges, setting, 
 pivots & glands
Check for any corrosion 
 in the gate body
Check the external 
 isolating cover
Check the adobes & external cement 
 layers
Clean from ashes
Check all parts
Assemble the element & close the 
 doors
Check the condition (open & close)
Adjust
Check after repairing
Restore all valves to the operation normal position
Clean the area after repairing
